get.summary: Read business metrics and source status
get.description: Owner only. Reads the current bounded in-memory snapshots without issuing provider requests. Missing configuration and unavailable data remain explicit; no demo KPIs are substituted. User identity is required after the first account is created. Before account bootstrap, the installation API authentication gate supplies the CEO identity. The outer API authentication and rate limits still apply.

post.description: Owner only. Executes an explicit read through the selected company agent and existing tool, SecretRef and approval policies. Denied, approval_required, error and not-configured outcomes are returned as source states in a successful snapshot; callers must inspect state. A refresh may contact the configured integration but does not perform a business write. User identity is required after the first account is created. Before account bootstrap, the installation API authentication gate supplies the CEO identity. The outer API authentication and rate limits still apply. When approval_required is returned, approve the referenced request through the Decision Inbox, then repeat this same refresh with the same agentId. The server rechecks permissions and resolves the persisted approval binding to company, source, agent, tool and fixed endpoint within 15 minutes. An approved, unexpired grant is consumed exactly once before the provider request. A network failure still consumes that grant; a later attempt may need a new approval. The strict request body does not accept approvalId.
